description: Lists the posts this Xyla shop will publish, day by day, for up to 7 days from a start date (the shop's today if left out). Each post has its platforms, send time in the shop's time zone, type, caption and media links. Posts waiting for approval are not here: use pending_approvals.

days.description: How many days to show, 1 to 7. Defaults to 7.

start_date.description: First day to show, as YYYY-MM-DD in the shop's time zone. Defaults to today.

name: upcoming_posts
title: Upcoming posts
